title: The Day of Atonement

questions.question: How often was Aaron allowed to enter the Holy Place behind the veil?
options: Only once a year on the Day of Atonement
questions.correctAnswer: Only once a year on the Day of Atonement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:2 (ESV): "Tell Aaron your brother not to come at any time into the Holy Place inside the veil... that he may not die."

questions.question: What two animals were taken from the congregation for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:5 (ESV): "And he shall take from the congregation... two male goats for a sin offering."

questions.question: What was cast over the two goats?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:8 (ESV): "And Aaron shall cast lots over the two goats, one lot for the Lord and the other lot for Azazel."

questions.question: What happened to the goat on which the lot fell for Azazel (scapegoat)?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:10 (ESV): "Shall be presented alive... to let it go into the wilderness to Azazel."

questions.question: What did the high priest wear during the service?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:4 (ESV): "He shall put on the holy linen coat and shall have the linen undergarment on his body..."

questions.question: What did Aaron have to create inside the veil to prevent death?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:13 (ESV): "And put the incense on the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat... so that he does not die."

questions.question: Where did Aaron sprinkle the blood of the bull?
options: On the front of the mercy seat and in front of the mercy seat
questions.correctAnswer: On the front of the mercy seat and in front of the mercy seat
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:14 (ESV): "And sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the mercy seat..."

questions.question: What did Aaron confess over the live goat?
options: The iniquities and transgressions of the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The iniquities and transgressions of the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:21 (ESV): "And confess over it all the iniquities of the people of Israel, and all their transgressions, all their sins."

questions.question: On what day of the year was the Day of Atonement?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:29 (ESV): "In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict yourselves..."

questions.question: What were the people required to do on this day?
options: Afflict themselves (fast) and do no work
questions.correctAnswer: Afflict themselves (fast) and do no work
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:29 (ESV): "You shall afflict yourselves and shall do no work..."

questions.question: Who led the scapegoat away?
options: A man who is in readiness (an appointed man)
questions.correctAnswer: A man who is in readiness (an appointed man)
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:21 (ESV): "And send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness."

questions.question: What was Aaron to do after sending away the goat?
options: Bathe and change back into his regular garments
questions.correctAnswer: Bathe and change back into his regular garments
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:23-24 (ESV): "Then Aaron shall come into the tent... put off the linen garments... bathe his body... and put on his garments."

questions.question: Where were the remains of the bull and goat for the sin offering taken?
options: Outside the camp to be burned
questions.correctAnswer: Outside the camp to be burned
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:27 (ESV): "Shall be carried outside the camp. Their skin and their flesh and their dung shall be burned with fire."

questions.question: What did the man who burned them have to do before re-entering the camp?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:28 (ESV): "And he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp."

questions.question: How long was this statute to last?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:34 (ESV): "And this shall be a statute forever for you, that atonement may be made for the people of Israel once in the year."

key_verse_text: For on this day shall atonement be made for you to cleanse you. You shall be clean before the Lord from all your sins.
